The space
Welcome to the Tiki Lounge — a thoughtfully designed Nashville townhome built for groups who want a real experience, not a generic stay.

The highlight is your private rooftop oasis with a hot tub, fire pit lounge, BBQ grill, lounge chairs, and plenty of seating for sunset hangs and late-night vibes. Inside, the fun continues in the converted garage game room, featuring a full tiki bar setup, lounge seating, and a space made for group nights.

With multiple levels, separate hangout zones, and 4 bedrooms / 4 full bathrooms (one for each bedroom), it’s spacious enough for everyone to be together while still having privacy. You’re also under 10 minutes to Broadway, and close to The Gulch, 12 South, East Nashville, and Music Row.

Perfect for friend trips, bachelorettes, bachelor weekends, families, and corporate retreats.

⸻

Townhome Layout

Floor 1
• Bedroom 1 + full bath: Queen bed
• Converted garage game room: Tiki bar + lounge + TV + games

Floor 2
• Bedroom 2 + full bath: Queen-over-Queen bunk
• Kitchen: Large island + 4 bar stools
• Dining area: Table for 6
• Living room: Large TV + electric fireplace + cozy seating
• Balcony: Bistro seating for two

Floor 3
• Bedroom 3 + full bath: Queen bed (“The Blue Room”)
• Bedroom 4 (Primary) + full bath: Queen-over-Queen bunk + oversized shower with dual shower heads + bench

Rooftop
• Hot tub + fire pit lounge + BBQ grill + lounge chairs + plenty of seating for the group

⸻

Guest access
Guests have full private access to the entire home, including the rooftop deck and the converted garage game room. No shared spaces.
